object.description: Settings allowing a CPE to configure and route IPv6 Dual-Stack Lite (DSLite) as specified in {{bibref|DSLite}}. The DS-Lite mechanism is intended to be implemented only on gateway devices that support IPv4 on the LAN side and only have IPv6 connectivity on the WAN side. See the Dual-Stack Lite Theory of Operation {{bibref|TR-181i2|Appendix VII}} for a description of the working of this DS-Lite data model.
